doNotRemote.description:
Default is false, i.e. remote execution of operations.
If true, signifies that the function should execute a variation of the implementation
if one exists, which is to run within the current jvm without performing any remoting operation.

dropCaches.description:
Default is false, i.e. used cached state of App, Env, or Cluster.
If true, signifies that the function should execute a variation of the implementation
if one exists, which is to not use any critical cached states (ex. Configs) and
instead drop necessary caches before performing the operation.
